name: open_binary
description: Open a local executable, application bundle, archive, JavaScript, source map, plist, or analysis database after validation. format=dos-com explicitly interprets 1..65280 headerless bytes as a DOS COM analysis image. format=raw-binary interprets headerless bytes with a required architecture and entry_point; file offset 0 maps at that address. Omission preserves header-based detection. provider_id selects one deep provider or deterministic auto selection; the binding remains stable until close or an explicit switch, with no failure fallback. Reopening the same target and profile retains its active database and metadata edits. Changing target or provider can retire the active Ghidra database and discard its ephemeral edits, including before a later provider call fails; retained investigation records are historical and do not restore those edits. For editable Ghidra persistence across processes, set REA_GHIDRA_CHECKPOINT_DIR to a private absolute directory in the startup environment (stock ELF/PE/Mach-O on Linux/macOS; restart MCP). Opens and normal close then restore/save automatically; no separate persistence tool or runtime setting update is needed. An optional analysis snapshot is imported atomically and must match the binary identity, concrete provider, and canonical analysis profile exactly; importing into a session with metadata mutations requires closing and reopening it first. Switching targets preserves investigation records. A failed admitted open reports error.details.selection_at_failure, target_at_open_completion, and provider_id_at_open_completion. The target summary and provider id are the selected binary and bound provider when that attempt settled, or null when absent. Later calls can change the selection, so use binary_session for current state. Call close_binary to release engine resources; reset_investigation explicitly clears investigation records.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. format=gamecube-dol takes powerpc from the header, so it must be omitted.

entry_point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex). File offset 0 is mapped here. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. Optional with format=gamecube-dol; must equal the DOL header entry.

flash_offset.description: Flash address (0xhex) of the dump's first byte, when it does not start at flash address 0. Only with format=esp-flash-image.

format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected), or esp-flash-image (an ESP flash dump read with flash_offset and partition_table_offset). Omission preserves header-based detection.

partition_table_offset.description: Flash address (0xhex, a multiple of 0x1000) of the partition table, which disables the table scan. Only with format=esp-flash-image.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.
